svg.title: Mockup 06: announcements on screen
svg.text: 06 · Announcements on screen: three levels, live edits and a withdraw, all owned by the arbiter
DEMO EVENT
Main hall
INFO
Pizza orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Demo Game Cup final 21:15 on stage
a · Info: a card in the rail
Rank 80, chain rail → ticker. A bell once on the sound screen; the line drains with
the time left; the rail's rotation resumes after.
DEMO EVENT
Main hall
INFO
Pizza orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Demo Game Cup final 21:15 on stage
b · Urgent: the card takes the screen's spotlight once
A ripple from the card's edge, the warning colour, the attention sound at full volume;
pushed to phones in quiet hours. Only people with the urgent right may send it.
DEMO EVENT
Main hall
UPDATED
Pizza is here · now at the info desk, not the café
c · Edited live: the card and the ticker line change in place
A moments.override.changed: no new sound, the time left is kept, an UPDATED chip for 60 s.
DEMO EVENT
Main hall
INFO
Pizza orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Demo Game Cup final 21:15 on stage
d · Withdrawn: gone from every screen at once
The rail resumes where its rotation would be now (on_end: resume); no "cancelled" sound.
